subject: Virtual coffee? - perception data quality
text:
Hi [NAME] - Happy new year! Noticed ramping up the floor cleaning robot
fleet is on the agenda for [COMPANY] this year so I wanted to reach out for a
quick coffee.

In case Encord is new to you - we work with robotics teams e.g. Dyna
Robotics, 1X and Boston Dynamics - helping them automate annotation and
improve data quality across detection, classification and mapping tasks at
scale.

I saw 3D geometry-based vision algorithms is a large part of your
perception stack - so I'd love to share learnings from supporting Zipline's
3D team as well.

Keen to hear what's top of mind for you for [YEAR] - would afternoon times
next Thursday work for a quick coffee?

subject: Optimising model development - Encord invite
text:
Hey [NAME],

I hope you're doing well and have had a good start to [YEAR].

I've been chatting with Mateusz Wozny about your processes for preparing data for model training at Asseco. We were supposed to have a meeting this afternoon, but he recommended that I reach out to you.

My team at Encord has been working with companies like Augmundo and Standard AI, helping them to develop their models more effectively. These teams move over to our platform when they start facing bottlenecks in between their data collection and model training.

They do this, because our platform offers multimodal data annotation and curation, flexible workflows and ontologies, and dashboards that allow you to really optimise your teams productivity.

I'd love to grab 20 mins of your time to discuss your current data pipelines, and show you what our platform can do. I'm therefore very presumptively going to drop you a calendar invite for this Thursday - please change that however you like. Alternatively, feel free to book directly into my calendar here.

subject: Virtual Coffee - road/ driver safety
text:
Hi [NAME],

vision-based model for AI Dashcam is a key focus for your team, much like
our customer Motive. So I wanted to reach out for a virtual coffee.

processes. On Encord, technical teams can curate datasets from million

program managers have clearer understanding over label quality and
workforce productivity.

improved. Would you be open to a virtual coffee afternoon times tomorrow?
